events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who died on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his tragic passing, Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: Today we remember Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. Which track showcases his genius best for you?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary, let alone the tracks inside. What's your top pick from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the inimitable Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' sound is still as fresh as ever. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice, the attitude, the tunes. What's your favourite Liam moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released the 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, it changed how we listened to music forever. Who still has theirs somewhere?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, who's your favourite Bond and which track gets you in the 007 mood?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Talent
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. It marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your go-to track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally. What's his most impactful song for you?
